ye-at-end-of-questions.title: Kòman manman w ye?
ye-at-end-of-questions.bodyMarkdown:
Use **ye** at the end of several common question patterns.

For example:

- **Kòman manman w ye?** — How is your mother?
- **Ki bò liv la ye?** — Where is the book?

The question words are already familiar. Focus on **ye** at the end of each question.

ye-with-who-what-time.title: Ki moun li ye?
ye-with-who-what-time.bodyMarkdown:
Here are three more questions with **ye**:

- **Ki moun li ye?** — Who is he?
- **Ki sa sa a ye?** — What is that?
- **Ki lè li ye?** — What time is it?

Keep the familiar question words and notice how **ye** closes each complete question.

ye-closes-a-statement.title: Se sa li ye.
ye-closes-a-statement.bodyMarkdown:
You can also use **ye** to close this statement:

- **Se sa li ye.** — That’s what it is / that’s the way it is.

Here, **ye** still comes at the end.
